700098.t: From ἀ- (a-) + βυθός (buthós, “depth of the sea”) Compare Sanskrit अगाध (agādha, “fathomless; abyss, chasm”).

700089.t: ἀ- (a-, “not”, alpha privativum) + βουλή (boulḗ, “will, determination, decision”) + -ία (-ĭ́ā, abstract-noun-forming suffix)

700090.t: According to Beekes, from ἁβρός (habrós, “delicate, graceful”).

700023.t: From ἀ- (a-, negation prefix) + βατός (bătós, “passable; accessible”).
